experiments.scope: B' runs 0, 1 of pre-registration A (proof 4.2; k = 0 is the advice of the v6 full-scale run). For each advice k in turn (trials 2q, 2q+1 for the q-th): trial 2q re-runs, from the run's label alone, the setup of the candidate c that produced the advice and its accepting attempt j (BRUNS[k]); PASS iff the setup's row-operation count, the attempt's status, DF and row count, and SHA-256 of the output advice equal the log (the budget counter itself is executed by r5-bpfull). Trial 2q+1 re-runs one other logged attempt j' < j of the same candidate, chosen by SHA-256 of the trial seed; PASS iff status, DF and row count match. Then trials 4..67 run one connector attempt each (cap 2^18 work units, DMIN 33) on advice k = ks[t mod 2] with coin words from the organizer seed (class Coins); PASS iff accepted and two sampled solutions satisfy Lemmas 1-2 (proof 2.5), FAIL otherwise; the facts of proof 3 for that advice are checked first. Other trials return no pair. PASS = (00^135, 01||00^134) satisfies the declared event; FAIL = (00^135, 02||00^134) does not. Both are fixed sentinels, so the host check is vacuous; the evidence is the organizer's execution of the visible code, and the host-counted numbers are successes (PASS) and returned_pairs (PASS + FAIL).

experiments.scope: Exact recount of the trail search P (proof 2.1) for start lanes 0, 1. Trial 0 runs T1 (the depth-first search of in-kernel cores of at most 10 bits) from bit (lane, z = 0) of each lane of the group, counting every node, and for each core found whose smallest lane is in the group computes C1 (alpha4 compatible with beta3 = T2 leaves), decides P45 > 0 exactly (pruned search over the same alpha4), and computes C2 (beta2 compatible with alpha3 = T3 leaves) if P45 > 0. PASS iff the per-lane node counts and the group totals equal GROUP_LOG. The groups 0..3 (lanes 0-1, 2-7, 8-16, 17-24) partition the cores; P45 > 0 is decided by a depth-first search that remembers failed partial states. Other trials return no pair. PASS = (00^135, 01||00^134) satisfies the declared event; FAIL = (00^135, 02||00^134) does not. Both are fixed sentinels, so the host check is vacuous; the evidence is the organizer's execution of the visible code, and the host-counted numbers are successes (PASS) and returned_pairs (PASS + FAIL).
experiments.hypothesis: P's counts that enter the time bound are exact. Predicted: PASS with 692,664 nodes, 1023 cores, sum C1 = 974,737,408, 204 cores with P45 > 0, sum C2 = 608,900,651,514. Over r5-trail-0..3: 8,674,833 nodes, 1741 cores, C1 = 1,639,088,128, 467 kept cores, C2 = 1,379,275,399,350, the counts in P's counted bound of 2^37.950 units (budget 2^37.968 with the full-w1 counter).

experiments.scope: The counted word-RAM program of E's stage 1 (proof 2.4): every operator on class W counts one primitive, load() one, test() two (comparison and branch). First checks that EQS is a basis of the equations of the 10 round-2 rows. Trial t < 64: x and one basis vector from SHAKE-256 of the organizer seed; one Gray step and the early-abort test; PASS iff the round-1 output equals a plain evaluation, the exit equals the first failing equation of a plain evaluation of u = L(round-1 output), and the count equals COST[exit]. Trials 64..88 force exit k = t - 64 (every path) and check COST[k]. Trial 89 counts the control of 16 blocks of the unrolled Gray loop (15 each) and the basis indices 4 + ctz(m). Trials 90, 91: the counted form of one pass of P's T3 loop (t3_step; trail3c.cpp): the step counters and threshold, m0 = 9 leaves (the smallest row-0 fan-in) on the longest non-full path (all 5 planes of the AS test), then the Gray step on its longest branch; PASS iff the AS values and the alpha2 update equal a plain evaluation and the count equals T3_STEP = 1750 <= 9 x 256. PASS = (00^135, 01||00^134) satisfies the declared event; FAIL = (00^135, 02||00^134) does not. Both are fixed sentinels, so the host check is vacuous; the evidence is the organizer's execution of the visible code, and the host-counted numbers are successes (PASS) and returned_pairs (PASS + FAIL).
experiments.hypothesis: E's stage 1 costs at most COST[24] + 15/16 < 594 primitives per pair, the charge of proof 6; a T3 leaf of P costs at most 2^8 primitives including its share of the Gray step (1750 / 9 = 194.5, margin 1.32). Predicted: 92 PASS in 92 returned pairs.
